summary: Zenta Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an extraordinary general meeting to be held September 30, 2026 at its Macau executive office, with a record date of September 8, 2026. The filing contains only the press release, EGM notice, and form of proxy; the excerpt does not disclose the specific resolutions to be voted. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation appear. This is a routine meeting notice rather than a special situation, so the event-driven angle is limited absent the underlying agenda items, which remain the key unknown to watch.
